name: Asahi
source:
"We believe that one day, our light will illuminate the entire idol world!"

A genius performer from the new idol group "Starfire." Inspired by his father and older brother, he's determined to become "the most all-loving god." Bright and energetic, he bounces back quickly from setbacks and doesn't dwell on complicated problems.

Zodiac: Taurus
Animal Aspec: Dog
Hobby: Outdoor activities
